original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-functor-on-fp-modules}
Let $A$ be a ring. Let $\mathcal{B}$ be a category having filtered
colimits. Let $F : \text{Mod}^{fp}_A \to \mathcal{B}$ be a functor. Then $F$
extends uniquely to a functor $F' : \text{Mod}_A \to \mathcal{B}$
which commutes with filtered colimits.

semantic_review_note: The pinned lemma quantifies a ring A, a category B admitting filtered colimits, and an arbitrary functor from finitely presented A-modules. Its unique colimit-preserving extension to all A-modules is exactly the claimed conclusion. The section's Mod^fp notation is finitely presented modules; no additivity or exactness is assumed.
